{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers AND exclude missing age (-1)
converted_df = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute the number of valid converted customers
n_valid_converted = len(converted_df)

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = converted_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age: {n_valid_converted}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}')"}
